meta.parties: Wickremesinghe Et Al. v. Ensohamy Et Al

rules.statement: The identity of the subject-matter of a sale, even if mistakenly stated in the deed, does not necessarily affect the validity of the conveyance if the vendor has a valid title to the thing sold.
rules.supporting_quote: "The identity of the subject-matter of the sale would not be the same so as to enable us to hold practically that a conveyance of Blackacre, which she did not possess, must be deemed to a conveyance of Whiteacre, which she did."
